run_video_feature_extraction: run the video feature extractor CLI to extract features from videos in a directory
run_2d_cnn_extraction: run the video feature extractor with 2d CNN type to extract 2048-dim features
run_vmz_extraction: run the video feature extractor with vmz type to extract 512-dim features from videos
run_s3d_extraction: run the video feature extractor with s3d type to extract video embeddings from videos
run_vae_extraction: run the video feature extractor with vae type to extract 1024-dim image codes
